positions.name: PipelineSlugFallbackBehavior
positions.frame: how should the pipeline handle a memory submitted without an explicit id field?
positions.why: src-1 establishes the triggering condition — a memory arriving with no explicit id — and src-2 states the required response the pipeline must carry out in that condition (produce a slug via LLM id-gen or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit). Read together they describe a single behavior contract for the missing-id case, even though the acts differ (assertive fact vs. directive requirement) and the conviction pass reads them differently (claim vs. decision) — that gradient is exactly the join between condition and consequence, not two ungrouped facts.
